name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
